task.title: Add task sorting and filtering to desktop
task.description:
Allow users of the web UI/Desktop to sort tasks ascending/descending by:
 - Priority (default)
 - Task title
 - Most recently updated

For the web UI, allow different sortings for different columns.

Allow users of the web UI/Desktop to filter tasks by:
 - Task title
 - Priority
 - Labels

Allow users of the Web UI/Desktop to find/surface tasks by searching all text through a fuzzy search mechanism:
`workbook list --find (regex? text string?)` -> searches across titles, descriptions, labels, possibly comments

Also filter by project key. Once "Add a mechanism for switching to a new project key ID" lands, a project may have several task-ID keys (one current, others active or retired), and the CLI gains `workbook list --key <KEY>`. The web board and the desktop should offer the same filter, shown only when the project has more than one key, with retired keys included since their tasks still exist. The board has no filter chips today; the Deleted switch (`/?deleted=1`, address-driven through `navigate()`) is the precedent for board-scoped, bookmarkable state.
